notes.title: Linux and MacOS versions fixed
notes.notes:
We've updated the Unity engine to version 5.4 and removed the launcher that was previously attached before the settings.

Mac and Linux versions should be fixed as well, if there are any errors please post them in the discussions as we are actively monitoring to make sure this patch works as intended.

Thank you for playing and enjoying Flight of the Paladin!

notes.title: Patch 1.05 notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for your support, comments and criticisms. It's thanks to you that we can make this game even better! In this patch we've decided to address some of the gameplay issues that have been brought to our attention.

Campaign Mode changes:
-The length of the stages have now been shortened. The bosses will appear much sooner.

-If you reach a boss and die, you will respawn near that boss to try again.

-Paladin's collision box has been slightly adjusted.
